diagnostics.message: `module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app` pushes the webhook endpoint and secret to the GitHub App via a local-exec provisioner, but its only dependency on the webhook stack is the static endpoint string (which resolves to `aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook` plus a constant). Nothing orders it after `module.runners.module.webhook:resource.aws_apigatewayv2_integration.webhook` (nor the route, `$default` stage, or `aws_lambda_permission.webhook`), so the GitHub App can be updated to point at the endpoint before that endpoint is actually wired to the webhook lambda — GitHub would then deliver webhook events to a non-functional URL. Add an explicit `depends_on` from the null_resource to the API Gateway integration (route/stage/lambda permission are covered transitively or should be included too).
